rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an acidic taste or food that has turned sour; for sense 2 it describes a genuinely sour rather than strongly rancid smell or taste.

example.english: This lemon tea is very sour.
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 ning4 mung1 caa4 hou2 syun1

rows.note: Use this for a sour, sullen, or unfriendly facial expression or demeanor, especially a sour look.

example.english: They turn sour whenever they lose a game.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 syu1 bo1 zau6 hak1 min6

rows.note: Use this for a generally unfriendly or hostile attitude rather than specifically a sour-looking face.

example.english: That clerk was really sour toward customers.
example.traditional: 嗰個職員對客人態度好唔友善。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 zik1 jyun4 deoi3 haak3 jan4 taai3 dou6 hou2 m4 jau5 sin6

rows.note: Choose this over 酸 when food or breath has a distinctly stale, foul, or rancid smell or taste.

example.english: The overnight rice has a sour smell.
example.jyutping: di1 gaak3 je6 faan6 jau5 zan6 sau1 mei6
